description: A Word-like "Open document" dialog over an ITempoDocumentLibraryProvider: an XLarge modal with a collapsible WAI-ARIA folder tree (one roving tab stop, arrow keys), a right-pane breadcrumb (home icon, › separators), a searchable list/grid of documents with a sort indicator, always-visible actions (Rename/Delete disabled until a document is selected), an optional virtual "Recent" node (ShowRecent) and a link-or-copy choice presented as radio cards. Emits a DocumentOpenResult on confirm. The dialog measures its own body: below 768 px (or with LayoutMode=Tablet) the tree narrows and Cancel / Open take their own footer row; below 640 px (or with LayoutMode=Mobile) it is a fullscreen panel (TmModal MobilePresentation=Fullscreen) - no tree, the subfolders of the current folder as drill-down rows with a back button and the breadcrumb, two-line document rows with the PreviewSvg thumbnail and a per-row more menu (Rename / Delete), the Link / Copy radio cards as compact cards above a sticky TmMobileActionBar (New folder / Rename / Delete) beside the primary Open (the header close button is the Cancel), a footer that stays above the on-screen keyboard, and no double-tap open (Open is explicit). The returned DocumentOpenResult and the provider contract are identical in every layout. Colours come only from canonical core tokens (--tm-color-primary, --tm-color-primary-subtle, --tm-color-surface-hover, --tm-text-primary, --tm-color-danger(-subtle), --tm-bg-surface-secondary), so the accent follows the default blue, the opt-in indigo theme and dark mode; there is no hex fallback.

parameters.name: DefaultMode
parameters.description: Initial insert mode. Defaults to <see cref="DocumentOpenMode.Link"/>.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Which kind of documents to list.

parameters.name: OnSelected
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen document when the user confirms.

parameters.name: OpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog opens or closes.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size for browsing. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: ShowRecent
parameters.description: Adds a virtual "Recent" node above the folder tree. Selecting it browses with Scope = DocumentLibraryScope.Library, SortField = Modified, Descending = true and Take = PageSize through the existing ITempoDocumentLibraryProvider.BrowseAsync - no provider member is added. The query is explicitly library-wide (a search without a folder sends Scope = Library too); a provider without support for the wider scopes may degrade it to the root folder. Opt-in.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto measures the dialog body: below 768 px it goes compact (narrow tree, footer buttons on their own row) and below 640 px it becomes the mobile layout - a fullscreen panel with drill-down folder rows, two-line document rows, a row menu and a sticky footer holding the action bar. Tablet forces the compact layout, Mobile the fullscreen mobile layout and Desktop the wide one, all without importing the observer script, so a test or a host renders a layout without a DOM. The returned DocumentOpenResult is the same in every layout.

parameters.name: SearchDebounceMs
parameters.description: Search debounce in milliseconds. Defaults to 300; set 0 in tests.

parameters.name: ShowModeToggle
parameters.description: Whether to offer the link-or-copy choice. Defaults to true.
